name: D2 Visa (Entrepreneur / Independent Worker)

requirements.blocker_text: This requires a viable business plan (for company founders/investors) or documented qualifications and client contracts (for self-employed professionals/freelancers) — assessed case-by-case, with no fixed statutory minimum investment.
requirements.fix_path: Develop a business plan or secure qualifying client contracts.

requirements.blocker_text: This requires demonstrating subsistence means of at least €920/month (RMMG), on top of business launch capital — approximately €11,040 in liquid savings per applicant is common consular practice, though not a fixed statutory figure.
This requires a Portuguese tax number (NIF) and registration of the company or self-employment activity.
requirements.fix_path: Obtain a NIF and complete business/self-employment registration.

evidence_required.document: Business plan (company route) or qualifications and client contracts (self-employed route)
NIF (Portuguese tax number) and business/self-employment registration

sources.title: AIMA — D2 residence visa for entrepreneurs and independent workers
Portal de Vistos - Ministério dos Negócios Estrangeiros

notes: No statutory minimum investment — genuinely distinct from pt_golden_visa's fixed thresholds, closer in spirit to Germany's Freiberufler/self-employment route or the Netherlands' RVO points assessment, but with less formal scoring than either (case-by-case viability review rather than a points rubric). LIVE POLICY WATCH, not yet fully modeled as a separate route: Lei n.º 61/2025 created a new residence route specifically for entrepreneurs/innovative-project holders integrated into certified business incubators — its implementing details weren't fully confirmed during this research pass and it may warrant its own route file once its regulation is published, similar to how pt_job_seeker_skilled is being tracked as pending its own Portaria. Subsistence requirement formula-linked to RMMG, same reference variable as pt_d7/pt_d8/pt_d1.
